# skyhub_upnp (Resource)

UPnP settings (singleton, id `default`). Import with `terraform import skyhub_upnp.this default`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "skyhub_upnp" "this" {
  enabled = false
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `enabled` (Boolean) Turn UPnP on or off.

### Optional

- `advertise_interval` (Number) Advertisement period in minutes (1-1440, hub default 30).
- `advertise_ttl` (Number) Advertisement TTL in hops (1-255, hub default 4).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Always `default`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import skyhub_upnp.this default
```
